summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting routine share buy-backs and total voting rights. The company purchased 9.715 million ordinary shares for cancellation under a programme announced on 29 July 2026, paying a volume-weighted average price of 503.5487p per share. Shares bought from Citigroup Global Markets Limited on the London Stock Exchange; cancelled shares reduce issued capital to 13.498 billion shares. No board recommendation or advisors noted. The buy-back programme is ongoing; watch for pace of future purchases and any expansion, with risk-arb angle minimal as this is a routine capital return.
